result.text:
MASTER PARTICIPATING FACILITY AGREEMENT
This Master Participating Facility Agreement is made on the 9th day of April, 2023 between Crestline
Health Partners and Tamarack Oncology Partners.

1. DEFINITIONS
"Effective Date" means April 9, 2023. "Clean Claim" means a claim that can be processed without obtaining
additional information from the Provider. "Medicare Fee Schedule" means the applicable CMS fee schedule
in effect on the date of service. "Plan" means Crestline Health Partners. "Facility" means Tamarack
Oncology Partners.

2. TERM
2.1 The term of this Agreement begins on the Effective Date and ends on 08 Apr 2027, unless sooner
terminated.
2.2 Upon expiration of the term, this Agreement shall renew automatically for successive twelve (12) month
terms unless terminated in accordance with Section 2.3.
2.3 Either party may terminate this Agreement without cause by giving 120 days written notice.

3. COMPENSATION
3.1 Acute inpatient services shall be reimbursed at a per diem of $3,275.
3.2 General outpatient services shall be reimbursed at 90% of the Medicare Fee Schedule.

4. CLAIMS
4.1 The Plan shall pay each Clean Claim within 20 days of receipt. 4.2 The Facility shall submit claims
within 120 days of the date of service.

5. CREDENTIALING
5.1 The Plan shall complete credentialing within 45 days of a complete application.

6. GENERAL
6.1 This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Georgia.
Confidentiality. Each party shall keep the financial terms of this Agreement confidential and shall disclose
them only as required by law.
Insurance. Provider shall maintain professional liability insurance of not less than $2,000,000 per
occurrence.
Records. Each party shall retain records relating to services for 7 years following the date of service.
Disputes. The parties shall attempt in good faith to resolve any dispute through informal negotiation for up
to 30 days before pursuing other remedies.

AMENDMENT NO. 1
Effective April 9, 2024, the parties amend Sections 3.1 and 3.2 of the Agreement as set out below. All other
terms remain unchanged.
Section 3.1 is deleted and replaced with: "Acute inpatient services shall be reimbursed at a per diem of
$3,525."
Section 3.2 is deleted and replaced with: "General outpatient services shall be reimbursed at 100% of the
Medicare Fee Schedule."
